additional_info.subject: RE: ID0471126-DC/Si-D/PL-[Y2/RD 300000004032] OCPP-Central-System connection error: CRM:03056000903
additional_info.body:
Dear Poland Service Team,
I am reahcing out in regards of ticket
ID0471126.
I connected via ssh remotely to router XF4 of charger Y2/RD 300000004032 and I confirm that the SIM card is not detected by the router.
I tried to restart the router itself, but the SIM card is not detected.
It is necessary to go onsite
and verify if the SIM card cannot be read or if the router is defective and does not detect the SIM card anymore. If you require support from me on the onsite visit, please let me know in advance so that I can check my availability and support you.
Therefore I am moving the case
0471126
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-PL SI E Queue
.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-PL SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
